title: SemanticSearchResult
description: Phase 13. The result contract returned by data/src/search_embeddings.py's search() function -- one ranked chunk match for a single query. See data/schema/semantic_search_design.md §6 for the full rationale. `text` is resolved from the chapter's own knowledge_chunks.json at search time -- it is NEVER stored in PostgreSQL/embeddings_1024, which stays a ranked-pointer index, not an authoritative content store.

chunk_id.description: FK to knowledge_chunks.json's own chunk_id -- reused verbatim.

score.description: Cosine similarity computed by PostgreSQL as 1 - (embedding <=> query_vector). Higher is better. Mathematically in [-1, 1]; empirically closer to [0, 1] for related text, but this is NOT a guaranteed bound and NOT a threshold -- see semantic_search_design.md §7/§9. Never called 'confidence'.

embedding_model.description: e.g. 'BAAI/bge-m3' -- the model that produced BOTH this row's stored vector and the query vector it was ranked against (see §9's compatibility rule).

text.description: Resolved from the chapter's knowledge_chunks.json at search time -- the one and only authoritative source of chunk prose, never duplicated into PostgreSQL.
